subject: Transportation Systems
title: Vehicle-to-Grid Technology
description: A short lesson to help you apply Vehicle-to-Grid Technology.

hook.text: An electric car parked at home has a battery the size of a home energy storage system. Why not use it?

buildup.text: Vehicle-to-grid lets parked EVs feed electricity back into the power grid during peak demand.

discovery.text: A million EVs could provide the same backup power as a large power plant—all from parked cars.

twist.text: Frequent charging and discharging degrades batteries faster. Car owners worry about shortened battery life.

climax.text: New battery warranties and smart cycling algorithms are addressing degradation. Pilots are expanding globally.

punchline.text: Your parked car could power the neighborhood.

quiz.question: What is vehicle-to-grid technology?
options: Parked EVs feeding stored electricity back into the power grid
